goal.description: What you mark at the end to finish your game in the multiworld.

include_tracks.description: One check for each of the 32 base-game tracks, for finishing a race on it on any speed.

include_50cc.description: One check per track for finishing it on 50cc.

include_100cc.description: One check per track for finishing it on 100cc.

include_150cc.description: One check per track for finishing it on 150cc.

include_mirror_mode.description: One check per track for finishing it on Mirror Mode. Turn off if you have not unlocked it yet.

include_200cc.description: One check per track for finishing it on 200cc. Turn off if you have not unlocked it yet.

include_first_places.description: One check per cup for finishing 1st in the Grand Prix, on any speed.
